summary: Deschutes NF L-4 lookout cabin built 1931 half a mile south of Three Creek Lake, abandoned 1952; only concrete foundation blocks remain, per the FFLOS register.

facts.design: L-4 gable-roof groundhouse, 14x14 ft wood frame

visit.trail_note: The access road is very faint and hard to follow. The newer TWA Trail gives better access.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS places the cabin half a mile south of Three Creek Lake; the 1931 newspaper item places it on a ridge near Three Creeks Lake, northeast of Broken Top. The story follows the FFLOS wording.

notes_for_editor: Brief elevation 2247.9 m matches FFLOS 2,248 m; no correction needed. Fate and remains rest on two registers that agree (FFLOS and firelookout.com). Staffing names come from a Forest Lookouts page that reprints Bend Bulletin items; they are given as printed. No access level is stated in any source, so facts.access is omitted. Read budget: 1 WebSearch, about 5 page reads including one 404 map. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story now calls firelookout.com a second site rather than a register; the 1931, 1935 and 1938 items are dated by their newspaper dates (added as evidence); the location conflict is still resolved in favour of FFLOS.
